estate_label: Real property, title, and secured-debt estate
domain: deeds, title, mortgages, leases, easements, liens, UCC filings, public property, securitization, and property debt
scope: Parcel and title chains, deeds, beneficial and legal ownership, mortgages, leases, easements, covenants, liens, UCC financing statements, public property inventories, federal leases and disposals, HM Land Registry datasets, securitizations, and property-level debt. The estate preserves document, parcel, title, party, lender, instrument, execution, recording, release, and disposition identifiers.
why_new_estate: Local development, public money, offshore, state authority, and public-interest work all depend on title and secured instruments that currently remain dispersed among project-specific packets.

denominator_contract.unit: one property, parcel, title, lease, mortgage, easement, lien, UCC filing, public-property record, or release instrument
denominator_contract.inclusion_rule: Official land, recorder, assessor, public-property, UCC, securities, lease, bond, and local-agreement records with stable identifiers.
denominator_contract.exclusion_rule: Mailing address as ownership; assessor owner label as complete title; project control as beneficial ownership; debt announcement without instrument.
denominator_contract.time_window: historical through 2026-07-23, with each source query recording its own bounded window
required_null_controls: public property disposed or lease terminated
no exact parcel match under bounded recorder search

source_routes.bounded_output: Federal real-property inventory, agency, asset type, location, utilization, disposition, lease and performance information available through public datasets and reports.
source_routes.residual_fog: Security exclusions, asset-level suppression, leased-property counterparties, title instruments, and current occupancy may require agency records.

source_routes.bounded_output: Price Paid Data, UK and overseas company ownership datasets, title and property searches, transaction dates, addresses, company numbers, and title identifiers.
source_routes.residual_fog: Price data is not complete title; title registers and plans may require payment, beneficial ownership can differ, and Scotland/Northern Ireland use separate systems.

source_routes.bounded_output: Parcel identifiers, deeds, grantor/grantee chains, assessments, exemptions, values, and transaction dates.
source_routes.residual_fog: Coverage, fees, images, historical snapshots, ownership entities, and parcel crosswalks vary by county.

source_routes.bounded_output: UCC financing statements, debtors, secured parties, filing numbers, collateral text, amendments, continuations, assignments, and terminations where public.
source_routes.residual_fog: Search logic, fees, retention, debtor identity, collateral interpretation, and lapsed or terminated filings vary by jurisdiction.

source_routes.bounded_output: CIKs, accession numbers, filing types, Form D offerings, ownership, merger, and company filings.
source_routes.residual_fog: CIK resolution, filer/entity boundaries, amended filings, and governance-right extraction require estate-specific parsing.

source_routes.authority: Municipal Securities Rulemaking Board and issuers
source_routes.bounded_output: Official statements, continuing disclosures, debt service, event notices, and CUSIP-linked documents.
source_routes.residual_fog: Bond proceeds, draws, reimbursements, issuer accounting, and project-level cash flows require issuer records and audits.

source_routes.authority: Municipal clerks, development agencies, and public authorities
source_routes.bounded_output: Executed development, incentive, infrastructure, lease, disposition, community-benefit, and amendment instruments.
source_routes.residual_fog: Agreements are distributed across clerks, boards, project sites, and records requests; summaries are not substitutes.

decisive_output: property-instrument ledger from title and public custody through debt, lease, encumbrance, release, disposition, and explicit unresolved beneficial ownership
next_acquisition: join parcel, title, party, mortgage, lease, easement, lien, UCC, public-property, and release chronology
boundaries: Recorded title, beneficial ownership, occupancy, control, financing, development rights, and economic benefit are different predicates. An address match alone is not identity or ownership.
A surveyed and prepared estate is not an acquired, completed, or finding-bearing estate.
Official source availability is not evidence of a subject overlap.
